//: Build project: feeds rollup (which overrides `module` to node16 and turns declaration emit off — see rollup.config.js). Kept standalone rather than extending tsconfig.json — inheriting `noEmit` makes @rollup/plugin-typescript re-derive `module` and emit a spurious TS5110. It also applies the stricter index-safety rule that production code holds to (test fixtures index known-populated arrays, so it is not enforced there).
